findings.title: Cross-device archive cleanup failures do not restore the original copy
findings.evidence: Forced EXDEV on old dev directory move, copied directory, then simulated partial rmtree cleanup followed by PermissionError. The original dev/grader.txt remained missing after publish_stage returned an error, while backup/original/dev/grader.txt survived. moved_old is updated only when move returns.
findings.recommendation: Require same-device atomic rename or support recovery for an archive child whose cross-device move partially cleaned its source; test the failure boundary.
findings.resolution: Archive copying and complete content verification occur before mutation. Publication and rollback now use atomic os.rename within root and its holding directory. A partial final cleanup failure reports Do not start trials and retains the verified private archive.
